name: Question 13
problem:
Which of the following augmented matrices are in row echelon form?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & -6 & 3 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & -8 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 7 & 0 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}0 & 9 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
Remember that an augmented matrix is in row echelon form if its coefficient matrix satisfies the following conditions:

- All the zero rows (rows with only zeros), if any, are placed at the bottom of the matrix.
- Each leading entry of a row is in a column to the right of the leading entry of the row above it.

With that in mind, let's look at each matrix in turn.

- The matrix $A$ is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied).

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & -6 & 3 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & -8 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

- The matrix $B$ is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied).

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 7 & 0 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

- The matrix $C$ is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied).

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}0 & 9 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, $A,$ $B,$ and $C$ are in row echelon form.

Question 13
?

Which of the following augmented matrices are in row echelon form? A=[41200−63900−83000−10000],B=[070900−2000080000],C=[09−12001−10002].

a
B and C only
b
A only
c
A and B only
d
A and C only
e
A, B, and C
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Remember that an augmented matrix is in row echelon form if its coefficient matrix satisfies the following conditions:

  1. All the zero rows (rows with only zeros), if any, are placed at the bottom of the matrix.
  2. Each leading entry of a row is in a column to the right of the leading entry of the row above it.
With that in mind, let's look at each matrix in turn.

  • The matrix A is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied). A=[41200−63900−83000−10000]

  • The matrix B is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied). B=[070900−2000080000]

  • The matrix C is in row echelon form (both conditions are satisfied). C=[09−12001−10002]

Therefore, A, B, and C are in row echelon form.
